paragraphs: SWARCO supplies road marking systems, traffic technology and industrial glass products to the people who build and operate roads. The group is headquartered in Wattens near Innsbruck, Austria, and runs an international network of plants, offices and partners. Its portfolio reaches across road marking, signage, urban traffic management, parking, highway and tunnel management, public transport and street lighting.

For cycling infrastructure the company offers coloured area markings, using green for general lanes and red to flag spots where the risk is higher. Pictograms are made from preformed thermoplastics so they sit in a rider's line of sight. Choosing a system means weighing location, traffic intensity, cost and environmental compatibility. A separate line covers runways, taxiways and aprons, where markings have to hold up against fuels, deicers, engine oils and hydraulic fluids.

Airfield marking systems have been tested and approved by the German Federal Institute for Material Research and Testing. Airport paints and marking products are made in compliance with FAA and Federal specifications as well as EASA. The company counts 5,300 transportation experts and traces its outlook to founder Manfred Swarovski.

quote.text: Safely guiding the way for humans and machines.
